paragraphs: Rav Yehuda son of Rav Yitzchak.
Taanit 6b has Abaye referring to Rav Yehudah, son of Rav Yitzchak. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Shmuel, son of Rav Yitzchak, as in Berakhot 59a.
Zohar, Chayei Sarah, at folio 126, mentions Yehudah bar Yitzchak. Midrash Tehillim 55:1 and Midrash Shmuel 14:2 have Rabbi Yudan, son of Rabbi Yitzchak.

notes.text: The consulted Taanit 6b reads Yehudah bar Yitzchak. The exact Dikdukei Soferim Shmuel reading and the Zohar and Midrash edition readings cited here have not been independently inspected and remain Hyman’s report; no identity equivalence is inferred.
